Air Step.descriptionOnly: its speed falls to 5 feet at least; with 1 rank in Fly its speed isn't reduced, and with 5 ranks it takes no –4 on the skills; the –10 on Perception or Survival is a tracker's, at the table

Anchored Step.descriptionOnly: its speed falls to 5 feet at least; no effect while it climbs, flies or swims

Bestow Auras.descriptionOnly: no path: the auras moved are the caster's own (aura of courage's +4 morale against fear), the target their center, at the table

Blade Lash.descriptionOnly: no path: +10 on the one trip it attempts as it is cast, at the table

Blazing Rainbow.descriptionOnly: no path: the bow's +1 seeking brilliant energy arrows, and the bridge's bonus and penalty of the caster's Wisdom modifier, are their own

Blessed Fist.descriptionOnly: the +1 only for a creature already armed when unarmed (Improved Unarmed Strike, a monk's unarmed strike)

Blood Armor.descriptionOnly: no path: +1 enhancement to its armor each time it takes 5 points of piercing or slashing damage, +5 at most, at the table

Body Capacitance.descriptionOnly: no path: +3 on its one touch attack against metal, and the damage it stores, at the table

Bullet Ward.descriptionOnly: no path: +10 AC against one firearm attack for each bullet; the bullets' AC 24, 20 hit points and hardness 20 are their own

Creeping Ice.descriptionOnly: no path: the ice's 3 hit points per inch and its DC 15 + caster level are its own

Disable Construct.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Enchantment Foil.descriptionOnly: the caster level check against its ruse, DC 15 + caster level, is told here

Feast on Fear.descriptionOnly: no path: its 5 temporary hit points for each creature panicked, and the targets' 9 HD at most, at the table

Font of Spirit Magic.descriptionOnly: no path: allies' +2 sacred or profane on caster level checks, concentration checks and DCs of their spirit magic spells, at the table

Glue Seal.descriptionOnly: no path: the area's and the item's checks are against the spell's DC; sticky armor's –10 circumstance on Escape Artist, escaping a grapple and CMD against grapples is its wearer's, at the table

Guardian of Faith.descriptionOnly: shield of faith's deflection; the protection's +2 deflection doesn't stack with it, and its +2 resistance on saves

Heightened Awareness.descriptionOnly: the +2 competence on the Knowledge checks it is trained in, and the +4 on one initiative check as it is dismissed, are told here

Heightened Reflexes.descriptionOnly: no path: +10 competence on one Reflex save each ally picks, at the table

Hex Vulnerability.descriptionOnly: no path: a later casting's +4 on the target's save against it and –4 on the caster level check, at the table

Mantle of Calm.descriptionOnly: opponents' +2 on saves against its spells is told here

Monkey Fish.descriptionOnly: the +8 on Climb and Swim is the rules' for a climb or swim speed; no effect in medium or heavy armor or load

Persistent Vigor.descriptionOnly: its fast healing 2, and the +4 on a reroll of a save against disease or poison as it is dismissed, are told here

Planeslayer's Call.descriptionOnly: no path: allies' +2 on caster level checks against the outsiders' spell resistance, and the 10 points of energy resistance their spells ignore, at the table

Repair Undead.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Repair Undead, Mass.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

River Whip.descriptionOnly: no path: the whip's damage and a burning target's +2 on its next save to put out the flames, at the table

Silver Darts.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Sonic Form.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Vampiric Shadow Shield.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Whip of Spiders.descriptionOnly: no path: the whip's swarm damage and the swarm's 3 hit points are their own
